row_demand_by_DP.absent_head_scope: no immediate target projection in this positive dummy execution

stage_bound.scope: Four joint168 target prefill bodies with their own worker steps, final-layer dispatch IDs, explicit send and receive counts and immediate target heads. The zero reported head demand on the M416 DP1 dummy applies only to the immediate readout.
stage_bound.model: Sensitivity under a common EP16 retirement before downstream work, one dependency chain per phase, unchanged external gaps, fixed clocks and no transfer of eliminated work to another stage. Advancing the entire EP front by up to the largest pre-stage saving is credited, then the original last arrival to last exit is erased. Unchanged issuers and stage-relative gaps move with their prerequisites. Each local gather is charged its longest rank span, including waiting. The readout grants free native work through norm, excluding the invariant small logits projection. Scenarios which change upstream readiness, remove host launch gaps or let individual ranks use partial results before the common join need their own wider schedule model.
semantic_limits: Head-only row counts assume every other reader of final normalized or raw state is either inactive or handled separately. Ordered candidate demand is known by head arity and exact batch sizes. Unknown request order/draft counts yield a set of admissible owner histograms, not an observed selector.

M416 DP1 executes the full rank call despite no immediate head. A zero sender may still own experts for other senders. Never skip EP participation from local emptiness alone. Dynamic EPLB, routed-expert exports, graph addresses, true MTP, PP/pooling, prompt logprobs and raw-state consumers may force additional rows or statistics.

The observed CPU-visible diagnostic bank is excluded from model credit. No conversion of logical work reduction to service acceleration. Sparse token-ID hashing, quantization, accumulation order, all-rank shape agreement and downstream consumers still need a real implementation to establish equality.

limits: Conditional on the stage-relative submission and join assumptions in the source. The time allowance includes retained arithmetic on selected rows, selection/packing, TP/EP exchange, event/synchronization and any new work. The model gives the existing small head projection zero saving.

The common EP16 packet counts are logical row requirements on the indicated head-only branch before any runtime alignment and exclude other readers. The positive cross-DP reception lower bound follows only from observed aggregate six-choice conservation.

live_reader_test.scope: Two diagnostic C8 cases, same inputs and exact stock arithmetic; the treatment changed only already produced output values on large real eager DP batches. The retained selected vectors are checked at the actual target logits method. This does not attest arbitrary external readers, physical snapshot address removal, graph, small or dummy paths, a compact final FFN kernel or service speed.

packet_layouts.scope: Separate TP8 large real groups observed by the diagnostic; each group counted once. Compare existing SP row ownership with the smallest balanced fixed per-owner capacity or ragged delivery. Owner rank is floor(original global index / original SP shard rows). All observed padded lengths are divisible by eight. Selected output is one BF16[5120] vector per head index.
limits: Payloads are logical result-replica bytes, including self; a relocated row includes only its four BF16 residual planes and four FP32 premix values. Token IDs, router masks, metadata, transport protocol and TP/EP sync are separately required. No wire-rate or latency estimate.

The layouts are counterfactuals computed on exact observed indices. Different DP schedules are not joined by matching sample order. A shared EP16 launch size and zero senders still need coordinated valid-row masks, destinations, dummy participation and exact output/route order.

Poisoning stored values passed for these natural executions while preserving old allocation and all computation; numerical equivalence with different M, raw snapshot deletion/alias lifetime and dynamic fallback are independent obligations.

installed_MC2_preparation.scope: On CPU inside the 171 container, execute the actual installed SP prepare/finalize/prepare_input_ids bodies on the ten captured large DP groups, using exact selector order and one synthetic feature/logit column carrying row identifiers. The old context uses the local full padded row count as a conservative lower bound for the larger cross-DP context and a valid-prefix mask for the scheduled rows. The counterfactual context constructs validity bits per original owner and per selected slot.
limits: No MC2 communication, device kernel, actual token values, scoped runtime context mutation, cross-DP packet negotiation or service timings. The experiment tests the stock preparation contract for the specified inputs.

output_release.scope: Hold every prior target/draft iteration and every request start fixed. Advance only the first token publication for the current carrier. Each substitution ends at the measured first native Fill after the fifth score transition. The wide interval starts even before the selected target head. Rank-local, TP join and cross-16 clock bounds retained separately.
limits: The Fill is a device suffix marker. It is not the Python bookkeeping call, a client send or a completed D2H event. CPU submission intervals, later device or network release, other streams, changes to earlier iterations and overlap with the next target are not priced here.

The installed code and the separate EP0 metadata establish host ordering for the witnessed path, not wall-time alignment of that execution to joint168 or proof that every device task delayed a particular client output. The async wait is conditional on that source path and stream assignment.

statements.rows_and_cost: 对齐四批、16 个 rank 的最终 FFN 调用、调度步和实际词表读者。最后一层共有 26,318 个有效发送行、157,908 项专家分配，立即执行的目标词表投影只选 62 行。416 行批次里 DP1 没有立即目标投影，却接收了 9,081 项专家分配，按收发守恒至少 8,937 项来自另一个 DP。原排程下分阶段计算，只改最后 FFN 的历史首 token P90 上界为 9.429 ms，只改末端收集、复制和归一化为 13.563 ms。联合改写为 22.992 ms。若四批替代路径耗时相同，每批最多能用 2.018 ms 才能达到 1% 参考。
statements.reader_effect: 171 在两个同进程 C8 批次中各验证 8 份完整输出。候选的 5 个真实大 DP 批次按 TP 去重共有 26,288 行，原始四路状态全量填入 NaN，最终归一化输出的 26,244 个未选行同样填入 NaN，词表 head 实际收到的 44 个向量与改写前逐位相同。16 个 worker 的运行配置均为 DSpark 辅助状态路径，所测调用的 prompt 对数概率请求数为零。按原有行归属进行 TP8 定长发送共需 304 个结果行槽，允许重分布后为 64 个，至少需要迁移 30 个输入行。该对照保留了原计算与缓冲地址。改变运算行数后的逐位一致性、联合内核耗时以及小批次、空侧和图路径仍需分别验证。 在 171 容器的 CPU 上用同一批行号执行已安装的 MC2 准备函数，保留旧批次上下文会回填到 26,288 个行槽，旧有效前缀在所测输入上把 260 个填充位误当有效行。构建紧凑上下文后是 304 个行槽，逐位掩码错误数为 0。此项尚未执行新布局的设备通信。
statements.current_output: 在另一份已保存的 EP0 记录中，70 个 worker 步按顺序经过采样、Python 记账返回、DSpark 准备、合并草稿计算和采样函数返回。保持所有先前迭代不变，仅允许当前批次提前发布首 token，把草稿三层移出路径的历史 P90 上界为 6.400 ms。即使将边界放宽至最终 FFNPost 结束到草稿末端 Fill，最多也只有 12.807 ms。早发当前结果这一项跳过独立 TTFT 实验。Fill 后面的设备复制、host 投递以及能改变后续迭代的调度另行计价。
